bundle.shortDescription: A little companion at the top of your screen
bundle.longDescription: PeDitX-Goo puts a small animated companion at the top of your screen and chats with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint you point it at — 9Router, PeDitX-AI, or a service on your own LAN. No telemetry, no account; the key lives in the Windows Credential Manager.
